label: Admissions
title: Apply to the faculty
subtitle: Fill in this form to start an undergraduate application. The faculty office will follow up by email or phone.
infoText: This form collects your contact details and the program you want. It does not replace official university admission steps when those open for the year.

steps.one: Choose the program you want to study.
steps.two: Send your name, email, and phone number.
steps.three: Wait for the faculty office to contact you with next steps.

noteText: For official deadlines and documents, check faculty announcements or contact the office.

form.name: Full name
form.notesPlaceholder: Anything else the office should know

validation.nameShort: Name should be at least 2 characters.
validation.notesShort: Notes should be at least 10 characters, or leave the field empty.

success: Your application was received. The faculty office will contact you soon.
error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
